description: This file is a C++ header defining utility functions related to session server states and logging levels within the rialto::servermanager::common namespace. It declares functions for converting session states to strings, converting logging levels, and setting local log levels.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a SessionServerState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a service::LoggingLevel to a RIALTO_DEBUG_LEVEL.

methods.name: setLocalLogLevels
methods.description: Sets the local log levels based on the provided LoggingLevels object.
